title: Successor compatibility of ordinary composite scalar tensors
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E,L of Q_l, an embedding iota:E to L, and a scheme W. Let A be coefficient-extension systems [stage3-pur-extension-reduction-data], M an ordinary quotient tensor model [def-trf-completion-unit-models], rho ordinary finite scalar evaluations satisfying the ordinary unit equation [stage3-pur-scalar-cochain-evaluation], and association balanced finite tensor associations. Define a_n as rho after M.tensor, followed by finite scalar extension of M.evaluation, then association. For every complex P of completed-E coefficient modules (without any flatness, boundedness or good-complex condition), every n, degree i and site object U, the successor of A.scalar.model.E(M.tensor(P^i)), transported by a_(n+1) and a_n, is the published integralScalarTransition. More precisely the successor applied to any finite source section x is heterogeneously equal to a_n inverse applied to integralScalarTransition(a_(n+1)(x)). No comparison with an arbitrary direct model or gluing conclusion is included.

proof.text: For abstract finite coordinate isomorphisms, conjugate the system successor to a map between underlying abelian sheaves of the direct tensor objects. The proved sheafified tensor Hom-ext lemma reduces equality with the published integralScalarTransition to local pure tensors.
The fully proved pure-tensor successor calculation in balanced association coordinates identifies its value on every b tensor x with the inverse coordinate of red(b) tensor x.

The defining tensor formula of integralScalarTransition has exactly that value. Tensor Hom-ext gives equality of the conjugated maps; the proved conjugation section lemma cancels the two finite coordinate isomorphisms and gives the required HEq on every section. Apply this generic argument to the displayed composite coordinates.

theorem coefficientExtensionAssociation_successor
    (A : CoefficientExtensionSystems l E L ι W)
    (M : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E W)
    (ρ : ∀ n : ℕ, A.scalar.model.E ⋙ coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n ≅
      coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E)
    (hρ : IsCoefficientScalarEvaluationUnit l E L ι W A ρ)
    (association : ∀ n : ℕ,
      scalarReductionExtension l E W n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E ≅
        integralScalarReduction l E L ι W n)
    (hassociation : IsCoefficientExtensionAssociation l E L ι W A association) :
    let a (n : ℕ) := Functor.isoWhiskerLeft M.tensor (ρ n) ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (M.evaluation n) (A.levels n).model.E ≪≫ association n
    ∀ (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ)
      (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W (n + 1)).obj
        (A.scalar.model.E.obj (M.tensor.obj (P.X i)))).val.obj U),
      HEq (((coefficientSequenceTransition l L W (Nat.le_succ n)).app
          (A.scalar.model.E.obj (M.tensor.obj (P.X i)))).val.app U x)
        (((a n).inv.app (P.X i)).val.app U
          ((((integralScalarTransition l E L ι W n).app P).f i).val.app U
            (((a (n + 1)).hom.app (P.X i)).val.app U x)))
